name: Goodbrief
summary: Generator of random design briefs: pick a job type and industry and get a practice brief with company, job and deadline.
description: Goodbrief generates random design briefs for practice: choose a job type (logo, brand identity, illustration, packaging, billboard, website) and an industry, then generate a brief with a company name, company description, job description and deadline. Briefs are assembled randomly from a large database, so results can be odd; the generated brief can be exported. Made by Manu, with a separate mobile layout and a newsletter (v3.0).
contains: brief types: logo, brand identity, illustration, packaging, billboard, website
industries: technology, food, retail, entertainment, fashion, sports, education, travel, real estate, transportation
brief fields: company name, company description, job description, deadline
briefs randomly assembled from a large database of options
